metadata.description: Technical writing and documentation engineering plugins for Claude Code: API docs, READMEs, changelogs, release notes, tutorials, runbooks, specs, style guides, and more.

plugins.name: api-documentation
plugins.description: API documentation: docs-site architecture, OpenAPI reference generation and linting, operation-level writing, error catalogs, and SDK guides.

plugins.name: architecture-docs
plugins.description: Architecture documentation: Architecture Decision Records, C4 diagrams, arc42 sections, and data-flow narratives.

plugins.name: changelog-management
plugins.description: Changelogs: Keep a Changelog entries from git history, SemVer bumps, release cutover, automation tools, and user-facing release narratives.

plugins.name: cli-help-text
plugins.description: CLI documentation: --help output, usage lines, options, subcommands, man pages, and exit codes by POSIX and GNU conventions.

plugins.name: code-comments
plugins.description: Code comments: inline comments that explain why, and documentation comments (JSDoc, TSDoc, docstrings, rustdoc, godoc) with coverage checks.

plugins.name: content-strategy
plugins.description: Documentation strategy: content audits, Diátaxis classification, information architecture, roadmaps, and docs metrics.

plugins.name: developer-guides
plugins.description: Developer guides: getting started, CONTRIBUTING.md, environment setup, Diátaxis tutorials and how-tos, and integration docs.

plugins.name: documentation-testing
plugins.description: Documentation testing: link checks, runnable code examples, Vale and markdownlint style checks, and freshness detection in CI.

plugins.name: error-messages
plugins.description: Error messages: three-part messages, RFC 7807 Problem Details, error code catalogs, and localization-ready strings.

plugins.name: knowledge-bases
plugins.description: Knowledge bases: taxonomy, article templates, search findability, lifecycle, and metrics across common platforms.

plugins.name: onboarding-docs
plugins.description: Onboarding docs: quickstarts built for time to first success, prerequisites, expected output, and progressive disclosure.

plugins.name: proposal-writing
plugins.description: Technical proposals: RFCs, design documents, and PRDs with problem-first structure, real alternatives, and success metrics.

plugins.name: readme-engineering
plugins.description: READMEs: structure by project type, the 5-second test, copy-paste quick starts, badges, and validation.

plugins.name: release-notes
plugins.description: Release notes: audience-segmented notes, breaking changes with migration snippets, migration guides, and channel formats.

plugins.name: runbook-writing
plugins.description: Runbooks: incident response procedures and SOPs that work at 3am, with exact commands, verification, and escalation.

plugins.name: specification-writing
plugins.description: Specifications: testable requirements, Gherkin acceptance criteria, interface contracts, and state machines.

plugins.name: style-guides
plugins.description: Style guides: voice and tone, language and formatting rules, terminology glossaries, inclusive language, and Vale enforcement.

plugins.name: technical-blogging
plugins.description: Technical blogging: developer-focused posts, headlines, code examples, platform formats, and search optimization.

plugins.name: tutorial-creation
plugins.description: Tutorials: learning path design, atomic steps with expected output, checkpoints, and honest prerequisites.

plugins.name: user-documentation
plugins.description: User documentation: task-oriented guides and help center articles for non-technical readers, troubleshooting, and FAQs.
